title: Wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- straps -->
  <rect x='40' y='4' width='20' height='22' rx='4' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <rect x='40' y='74' width='20' height='22' rx='4' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <rect x='42' y='6' width='16' height='3' fill='#b07a44'/>
  <rect x='42' y='91' width='16' height='3' fill='#b07a44'/>
  <!-- buckle -->
  <rect x='46' y='88' width='8' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e8c25a'/>
  <rect x='49' y='90' width='2' height='6' fill='#b8912f'/>
  <!-- case -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='28' fill='#d8dce6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='28' fill='none' stroke='#f4f7ff' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- lugs -->
  <rect x='36' y='22' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#b9c0cf'/>
  <rect x='58' y='22' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#b9c0cf'/>
  <rect x='36' y='72' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#b9c0cf'/>
  <rect x='58' y='72' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#b9c0cf'/>
  <!-- dial -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='21' fill='#1c2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='21' fill='none' stroke='#3f5a8a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- hour markers -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='31' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='63' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <rect x='31' y='48.5' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <rect x='63' y='48.5' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <!-- quarter dots -->
  <circle cx='64.5' cy='35.5' r='1.6' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <circle cx='64.5' cy='64.5' r='1.6' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <circle cx='35.5' cy='64.5' r='1.6' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <circle cx='35.5' cy='35.5' r='1.6' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
  <!-- hour hand -->
  <polygon points='50,50 45.5,44 50,33 54.5,44' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- minute hand -->
  <polygon points='50,50 53,49.5 62,36 58.5,35.5' fill='#ff8fc8'/>
  <!-- center pin -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='1.2' fill='#fff6c8'/>
</svg>
